描述_EN: later european collectors gave these wares the fanciful name of ‘celadon’. resembling jade, they were admired for their tranquil beauty. green-glazed vessels were exported in large quantities to south-east asia and the middle east. the yaozhou kilns in shaanxi province excelled in the production of objects with bold carved or moulded designs under a green olive glaze. they were often used in buddhist tea ceremonies and meditation rituals. china produced many types of green-glazed wares, in shades ranging from olive to grass to grey-blue. the most popular examples were made in the south, at the yue and longquan kilns in zhejiang province, but some kilns in the north also specialised in green-glazed wares.
描述_ZN: 后来的欧洲收藏家给这些器物起了一个奇怪的名字 "青瓷"。 类似于玉石，它们因其静谧的美感而受到推崇。 绿釉器皿被大量出口到东南亚和中东地区。 陕西省耀州窑擅长生产绿橄榄釉下的大胆雕刻或模制图案的物品。 它们经常被用于佛教的茶道和冥想仪式中。 中国生产了许多类型的绿釉器皿，色调从橄榄到草到灰蓝不等。 最流行的例子是在南方，在浙江的越窑和龙泉窑，但北方的一些窑场也专门生产绿釉器皿。
